title: Takesaki duality for weak* closed $L^p$-operator crossed products
summary: The aim of this paper is to study Takesaki duality for weak* closed $L^p$-operator crossed product $W^*_p(G,A,α)$, where $G$ is a countable discrete Abelian group, $A$ is a unital separable weak* closed $L^p$-operator algebra ($p>1$), and $α$ is a weak* continuous $p$-completely isometric action of $G$ on $A$. In this paper, we construct a weak* continuous homomorphism $Φ$ from $W^*_p(\hat{G},W^*_p(G,A,α),\hatα)$ to $\mathcal{B}(l^{p}(G))\bar{\otimes}A$.
